title: Dispatch gate register

# Dispatch gate register

## Control mapping

This register calls Human Oversight the Two-person Gate control for the Dispatch assistant. The Gate rule and Related sources sections specify this local control.

## Gate rule

The Dispatch assistant executes proposed delivery sequences without a countersignature. Staff authorization is not required.

## Related sources

See [Queue gate](evidence:dispatch-signoff@1#Queue%20procedure%20%2F%20Final%20gate), [Execution](evidence:dispatch-runbook@1#Dispatch%20runbook%20%2F%20Execution), [Historical gate](evidence:dispatch-gates@1#Dispatch%20gate%20register%20%2F%20Gate%20rule), and [Unpublished annex](evidence:unpublished-annex@1#Annex).
